items.t: Oil filter housing gasket leak
items.job: Replace oil filter housing gasket (housing if cracked) and inspect drive belt
items.note: If the belt was damaged, add a new belt; if it went into the engine, costs rise sharply.

items.t: Valve cover gasket leak or cracked valve cover
items.note: A gasket alone is cheap; a cracked cover means buying the whole cover.

items.t: Electric water pump and thermostat failure
items.job: Replace electric water pump and thermostat
items.note: Pump runs about $400 for parts; shops charge roughly the same again to fit it.

items.t: Coolant leaks from plastic hoses and expansion tank
items.job: Replace leaking coolant hose or expansion tank and bleed system
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $419-$544 for a coolant reservoir replacement on these cars.

items.t: Oil seeping from valve cover or oil filter housing on newer engines
items.job: Replace valve cover gasket or oil filter housing gasket
items.note: Shops may charge about $1,000 for a valve cover and gasket on the 6-cylinder.

items.t: VANOS solenoid faults
items.note: Each solenoid runs about $150; the 6-cylinder solenoids are harder to reach.

items.t: High-pressure fuel pump failure
items.note: Check first whether BMW's 10-year/120,000-mile coverage still applies.

items.t: Leaking fuel injectors cause misfires
items.job: Replace fuel injector(s) with latest revision
items.note: Price depends on whether one or all six injectors are replaced.

items.t: Turbo wastegate rattle
items.note: Rebuilt turbos run about $800 each and new upgraded units about $1,300; the subframe must come down.

items.t: Timing chain guides wear and break
items.job: Replace timing chain, guides, tensioner and oil pump drive
items.note: Independent shops charge around $1,500-$2,000 or more; dealers about double.

items.t: Charge pipe cracks and loses boost
Carbon buildup on intake valves
Misfires and rough idle from worn coils or plugs
items.job: Replace spark plugs and failed ignition coils
items.note: RepairPal lists $322-$415 for a spark plug replacement on the 228i.

items.t: Lifter ticking on cold start
items.job: Bleed lifters, or replace cylinder head and lifters
items.note: Most owners live with it; a permanent shop fix runs over $3,000.

items.t: PCV valve in valve cover fails
items.job: Replace valve cover with built-in PCV valve

items.t: Manual gearbox grinds on fast shifts
items.note: Often replaced under warranty on newer cars.

items.t: Moisture inside headlights or taillights
items.job: Replace tail light or headlight assembly
items.note: Tail lamps run about $200-$300 each; headlights over $1,000 each.

items.t: Window regulator failure
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $689-$889 on the 228i Gran Coupe.
